summary: Children and adults with speech and language impairments, particularly those with autism and cerebral palsy, benefit from Cboard's augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) web application. The app aids communication with symbols and text-to-speech, supporting 40 languages. Translations play a crucial role in this project, contributing to the inclusion of children in non-developed countries. Cboard's primary goal is to facilitate communication for individuals with speech and language impairments. The project operates in a global context, with a focus on accessibility and assistive technology. It addresses the sectors of education, healthcare, and social welfare.
